title: The Art of Fugue, Contrapunctus 12, mirror fugue in four voices, rectus

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 9) in part, with the tenor's line in the alto, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the tenth). Soprano: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Alto: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1, inverted, in a sequence falling by a third every bar. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1, inverted. Bass: a figure from countersubject 1.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: From D minor to G minor

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 9) in part, with the tenor's line in the soprano, the lines moved by different intervals. Soprano: a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from the subject and a figure from countersubject 1. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From G minor to B♭ major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bar 9) in part, with the tenor's line in the alto, the bass's line in the soprano, transposed. Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: the opening of countersubject 1 and a figure from countersubject 1. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times). Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From B♭ major to D minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Free counterpoint: nothing here is traced to the themes.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Tenor: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 1 (bars 18–20). Returns in Episode 3 (bars 30–31). Returns in Episode 4 (bars 36–41).
